groups.title: Use
items: For compact topbar utilities such as language, grid, and contrast.
Always provide a clear accessible name.
Use selected when the button controls a toggle state such as grid or contrast.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not document search as Icon Button; search is an input.
Do not use selected for language unless it represents a real pressed state.
Do not add extra topbar utility examples without a product reason.

groups.title: Review
items: Check hit area, icon legibility, focus, and disabled state.
Confirm aria-pressed exists when selected is true.
Verify small viewports keep search as an input and utilities as compact controls.
